proof_body:
by
  intro a b
  have hp := abs_nonneg a
  have hq := abs_nonneg b
  have hr := abs_nonneg (a + b)
  have ht := abs_add_le a b
  generalize |a + b| = r at *
  generalize |a| = p at *
  generalize |b| = q at *
  have h1 : r / (1 + r) ≤ (p + q) / (1 + (p + q)) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)]
    nlinarith
  have h2 : p / (1 + (p + q)) ≤ p / (1 + p) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hp (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have h3 : q / (1 + (p + q)) ≤ q / (1 + q) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hq (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have h4 : (p + q) / (1 + (p + q)) = p / (1 + (p + q)) + q / (1 + (p + q)) := by
    rw [add_div]
  linarith
